title: DAY 14/90
MECHANISMS
scenes.sub: Theory of Machines begins: links that move
scenes.voice: Day fourteen of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge. Ninety five days to GATE, and today a new subject begins: theory of machines.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's subject is theory of machines. Our topic: mechanism analysis, the base for every linkage question in GATE.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover Grashof's law and inversions, instantaneous centres with Kennedy's theorem, velocity analysis, and acceleration analysis including the Coriolis component.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. If shortest plus longest is at most the sum of the other two, it is a Grashof chain. Fix the shortest link for a double crank, or a link next to it for a crank rocker.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Grab the free practice set with full solutions on Telegram now. Tonight's test runs from seven to nine P. M. in our one rupee challenge course.

scenes.title: Day 13 Toppers
scenes.voice: Day thirteen toppers! Kunal takes rank one with eight out of thirty. Rajeev Kumar is close behind at rank two, and Piyush Patel takes rank three. Congratulations!
